message: 労働は尊い

name: Synn
message: 「Phew...」
A blue sky that really makes for a great day of farming.
Today, I'm transplanting green pea seedlings.
I transplanted onions and spinach the other day, so the garden that got trashed by the Demons is gradually filling back up.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord. When can we eat this stuff?」

name: Synn
message: 「Around May next year.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Can't wait. Well, assuming the world is still around by then.」

name: Sasami
message: 「Bawk-bawk-baaaawk!」

name: Azel
message: 「Eek, wh-what is this!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Azel's getting attacked.」

name: Sasami
message: 「Bawk-bawk-bawk-baaaaaawk!」

name: Azel
message: 「Gah, ow-ow-ow, I'll kill you, I'll kill you, I'll kill you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」
The feathers scattered everywhere speak to the ferocity of the attack.
Though this happens all the time.

name: Azel
message: 「Y-you, do something about this!」

name: Sasami
message: 「Bawk-bawk-bawk-bawk-bawk!」

name: Azel
message: 「Eeeeeek!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sasami! Easy now, there, there.」

name: Azel
message: 「Ow, ow! H-hurry up and help me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sasami, Sasami. This guy's okay. Look, an earthworm.」

name: Sasami
message: 「Baaaawk!」
The death throes of an earthworm.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Everything's fine now.」

name: Azel
message: 「Phew...」

name: Synn
message: 「What's up all of a sudden?」

name: Azel
message: 「While I was taking photos of your house, this bizarre creature attacked me!」
As Azel said that, she aimed her digital camera at Sasami, who was tearing apart and eating an earthworm.

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry about that. Sasami's shy, so she likes to play-bite people the first time she meets them.」

name: Azel
message: 「That was an attack.」

name: Synn
message: 「I gave her a good talking-to, so next time it'll only hurt a little.」

name: Azel
message: 「There won't be a next time.」

name: Azel
message: 「What were you doing?」

name: Synn
message: 「Tending my home garden.」

name: Azel
message: 「What is a home garden?」

name: Synn
message: 「Seeing is believing. Come over here.」

name: Azel
message: 「A farm field?」

name: Synn
message: 「I wouldn't go as far as calling it a farm. It's small enough to tend in my spare time at home, so it's a home garden.」

name: Azel
message: 「You grow these yourself?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Azel
message: 「Do you eat them?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yep.」

name: Azel
message: 「How industrious.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're not going to call it pointless?」

name: Azel
message: 「If there is a purpose, and that purpose is essential for survival, it is not pointless.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not that desperate, though... Anyway, why'd you come all the way over to my place?」
Azel opened up her digital camera and showed me the LCD screen.

name: Azel
message: 「This.」
Standing close beside me to show the screen, Azel was even smaller and more slender than I was.

name: Azel
message: 「Is something wrong?」
Azel asked as she flipped through the photos one after another.

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, it's nothing. So, what about this cat? Doesn't seem like there's any problem...」
In the photo she stopped scrolling on, a cat was napping on top of the Meteor Shopping District arcade.

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be a Demon!?」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thought so.」

name: Azel
message: 「Forget it.」
Going out of her way to show this photo means.

name: Synn
message: 「Did you like it?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's not like that. I just happened to take it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Cute, isn't it.」

name: Azel
message: 「Wh-What are you grinning at.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're imagining things.」

name: Azel
message: 「I was merely curious how it would get down.」

name: Synn
message: 「What happened?」

name: Azel
message: 「It climbed down nimbly right in front of me.」

name: Synn
message: 「So you waited until it came down.」

name: Azel
message: 「Ahem. State your business.」
Once again, several photos were sent and then stopped.
They were photos of Eauderourke working at a beef bowl restaurant.

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like he's working properly.」

name: Azel
message: 「Indeed.」

name: Synn
message: 「Honest labor is noble, isn't it.」

name: Azel
message: 「Certainly.」

name: Azel
message: 「No, that is not the case! Why do you not drive them away.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eauderourke? Why?」

name: Azel
message: 「Driving away Demons is your job, is it not.」

name: Synn
message: 「This is part of the job too.」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not quite understand what you are saying.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I think the Crusaders' job isn't to drive away Demons, but to solve the troubles that happen between humans and Demons.」

name: Azel
message: 「Then drive them away.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eauderourke only came to this world looking for delicious food, it's not like he's thinking of doing anything bad.」

name: Synn
message: 「The problem is just that he doesn't have money, so if he works, earns money, and eats with it, that solves everything, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「No human would willingly hire a monster like this. This Demon must have threatened them into letting him work. That is a problem.」

name: Azel
message: 「If you leave such lawlessness unchecked, your reputation will suffer as well.」

name: Synn
message: 「So you were worried about us.」

name: Azel
message: 「N-Not necessarily.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. Eauderourke didn't threaten anyone.」

name: Azel
message: 「Trust without basis is worthless delusion.」

name: Synn
message: 「Basis or whatever, I put in a good word for him at the beef bowl shop earlier this morning.」

name: Azel
message: 「W-What did you say!」

name: Synn
message: 「The folks at the beef bowl shop had seen Eauderourke working hard at KiraFes, too, so things went smoothly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Though they seemed surprised he wasn't wearing a mascot costume.」

name: Synn
message: 「While I was at it, I got Sally hired too. They were both super happy, saying they can eat beef bowls openly from now on.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, as long as they pay, they're customers.」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」

name: Synn
message: 「Manners are necessary, sure, but despite how he looks, Eauderourke is pretty obedient, so if someone corrects him, he'll learn right away.」

name: Azel
message: 「Setting that girl aside, from your perspective, this thing is a grotesque monster, is it not.」

name: Azel
message: 「The accounting girl is an old acquaintance of yours, and she's used to demons, so if you push the issue, she'll probably hire those monsters, but.」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean the Delicious Food Squad?」

name: Azel
message: 「Yes. However, you should know that is an exception.」

name: Azel
message: 「In the first place, they are things to be eliminated, which is why you were all given enough combat power to crush their resistance.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think that power is simply there to give us more options.」

name: Azel
message: 「Options?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think all demons are good guys. But that's the same as how there are bad guys among humans, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「A lot of trouble happens with demons, sure, but a lot happens between humans, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eliminating everyone who causes trouble would be tyrannical, wouldn't it? We exist to look for other methods and carry them out.」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't tell me... are you saying we aren't any different from them? You don't find them repulsive? Aren't you afraid of them?」

name: Synn
message: 「They just look a little different. That's a trivial thing.」

name: Azel
message: 「Trivial? You and these demons are completely different.」

name: Synn
message: 「There are plenty of gluttonous people in this world. On top of that, Eauderourke just didn't know how the economy works. That's all it was.」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, there was also one who liked hitting on girls. Some people might say that act itself is a problem, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「If that were the case, we'd have to attack everyone who flirts with girls, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「...You speak of them almost as if they were your own kind.」
Inwardly, I gave a start.
Maybe that's true. I'm the Demon Lord, and they're demons.
I don't seem to have any authority at all, yet I might actually be their king.
Even so.

name: Synn
message: 「I think trying to work things out by treating them as equals is way better than dividing everyone into friend or foe without even trying to understand them from the start.」

name: Azel
message: 「If you assume you understand them halfway, you'll have the rug pulled out from under you.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's still better than just fighting without knowing anything. There's no future in fighting, but I feel like there is a future in trying to understand.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides. Since they came all the way to this world, don't you want them to take home good memories?」

name: Synn
message: 「It'd be the best if they went home having come to like this world and the people living in it. If more people like that appear in both of our worlds, I think conflicts will decrease, too.」
I felt a little self-conscious. Besides, it was the first time I'd ever put my vague thoughts into words so coherently.
Still, I realized that this was truly what I believed.

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you.」

name: Azel
message: 「W-Why are you thanking me?」

name: Synn
message: 「You went out of your way to come tell us because you worried our reputation would suffer if Eauderourke caused trouble, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「Because you guys are the only ones who can drive that monster away.」

name: Azel
message: 「That's the only reason, got it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you.」

name: Azel
message: 「You're weird.」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so?」

name: Azel
message: 「I've never seen anyone like you. You're far more mysterious than that strange creature.」
